title: Nutty Middle Eastern Flaxseed Curry
description: A creamy, nutty curry packed with proteinrich flaxseed, finished with a fragrant tadka of cumin and cilantro, perfect for postworkout nourishment.
instructions: In a blender, combine soaked cashews, almond milk, ground flaxseed, and a pinch of salt. Blend until completely smooth. Set aside.
Heat coconut oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3‑4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the onions, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in garam masala and smoked paprika, toast for 30 seconds to release aromas.
Pour in diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, allowing the tomatoes to soften and release juices.
Add the chickpeas, then pour the cashew‑flaxseed cream over the mixture. Stir gently to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, letting flavors meld. Stir occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt; finish with a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
